name: The Stone Circle
summary: Marvon Rivetseeker once went into the Sunken Temple and only just got out. A round stone with a serpent symbol, now sitting in Marvon's workshop in Ratchet, might let Marvon tell you more, and you are asked to fetch it.

sections.title: Marvon's Memory
sections.body: Marvon Rivetseeker speaks of the evil in the Sunken Temple that seeps into everyone who walks its chambers. Escape was a struggle through the ooze now spread across the floors, and what remains is a memory of a big round room crowded with statues of serpents.

sections.title: The Stone in Ratchet
sections.body: Marvon has since come across a round stone that seems to bear the same serpent symbol. Marvon had it crated and sent on to the workshop in Ratchet. Fetch it and Marvon may have more to share.

sections.title: When the Stone Returns
sections.body: Seeing the stone, Marvon confirms it is the right one and says it is all coming back.

aliases: who gives the stone circle quest
faq.answer: Marvon Rivetseeker is the one who sends you for the stone. Marvon once entered the Sunken Temple and barely got out.
It was crated and sent on to Marvon's workshop in Ratchet.

faq.q: Why does Marvon want the stone circle?
faq.answer: The stone carries a serpent symbol like the statues Marvon recalls from a round room in the Sunken Temple. With it in hand, Marvon may be able to say more.

faq.q: What happened to Marvon in the Sunken Temple?
faq.answer: Marvon barely found the way out, wading through the ooze spread across the floors. All Marvon can recall is stumbling through a large round room filled with serpent statues.
